models.name: HP 250R G10 Notebook
models.shortDescription: The HP 250R G10 is a 15.6-inch business notebook from HP's commercial range, supplied for office and procurement use in several memory and storage builds.
models.description:
The HP 250R G10 Notebook is part of HP's business notebook range, supplied for office, government and education procurement. Builds listed differ by processor, memory, storage and warranty, and the notes against each say what is in the box.

All builds here are supplied without Windows, for organisations that image their own machines. Part numbers are listed against each build so a quotation can be raised against the exact one you need.
businessFeatures: Commercial range, eligible for standard-build and lifecycle terms
FreeDOS or DOS specified at order, for organisations that image their own machines
Warranty and carry-bag inclusion vary by build and are listed against each one

configurations.note: FHD display. Spill-resistant backlit keyboard with numeric keypad
